description: This file is a PHP source file responsible for handling AJAX requests related to campaign list relations in the vtiger CRM system. It initializes a query generator for custom views, fetches related records based on the list type (Leads, Contacts, Accounts), and relates entities accordingly before redirecting to an AJAX handler.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: A class used to generate database queries based on the current view and filters.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class providing entity-specific functions for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: initForCustomViewById
methods.description: Initializes the query generator for a specific custom view ID.

methods.name: initForDefaultCustomView
methods.description: Initializes the query generator with the default view settings.
